run_batched_training: run the batched synchronous actor/learner training loop with TVT rewards for a pycolab game
run_agent_with_memory: run the RMA agent with external memory and observation reconstruction enabled
run_tvt_rewards: run the TVT reward computation using read info and baseline values from agent steps
run_pycolab_environment: run a batched pycolab environment for key_to_door or active_visual_match games
run_tensorboard_logging: run training with tensorboard logging to track rewards loss and TVT metrics
